fonts.display: 'Optima', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Arial', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Bone Canvas
palette.role: Primary page background — warm off-white, the entire site sits on this paper-like canvas rather than pure white

palette.name: Press White
palette.role: Alternate surface for product cards, input fields, and crisp overlays that need to separate from Bone Canvas

palette.name: Onyx Black
palette.role: Primary text, hairline rules, filled action buttons, icon strokes, and nav borders. The structural ink of the system

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text and icon color — a softened black for less critical copy and outline button borders

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Deep alt-black for button borders, dark badges, and high-contrast text on white surfaces where pure black feels too harsh

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Button border accent — a near-black used for refined button outlines

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Badge and secondary text — sits between Graphite and Carbon for mid-emphasis labels

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Body text secondary and subtle borders — warm-leaning gray that pairs with the cream canvas without going cold

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.
